params.name: api-path-prefix
params.description: An API path prefix inserted between '<host>:<port>/' and '/api2/'. Can be useful if the InfluxDB service runs behind a reverse proxy.

params.name: bucket
params.description: The InfluxDB bucket/db. Only necessary when using the http v2 api.

params.name: delete
params.description: A list of settings you want to delete.

params.name: digest
params.description: Prevent changes if current configuration file has a different digest. This can be used to prevent concurrent modifications.

params.name: disable
params.description: Flag to disable the plugin.

params.name: max-body-size
params.description: InfluxDB max-body-size in bytes. Requests are batched up to this size.

params.name: mtu
params.description: MTU for metrics transmission over UDP

params.name: organization
params.description: The InfluxDB organization. Only necessary when using the http v2 api. Has no meaning when using v2 compatibility api.

params.name: otel-compression
params.description: Compression algorithm for requests

params.name: otel-headers
params.description: Custom HTTP headers (JSON format, base64 encoded)

params.name: otel-max-body-size
params.description: Maximum request body size in bytes

params.name: otel-path
params.description: OTLP endpoint path

params.name: otel-protocol
params.description: HTTP protocol

params.name: otel-resource-attributes
params.description: Additional resource attributes as JSON, base64 encoded

params.name: otel-timeout
params.description: HTTP request timeout in seconds

params.name: otel-verify-ssl
params.description: Verify SSL certificates

params.name: path
params.description: root graphite path (ex: proxmox.mycluster.mykey)

params.name: port
params.description: server network port

params.name: proto
params.description: Protocol to send graphite data. TCP or UDP (default)

params.name: server
params.description: server dns name or IP address

params.name: timeout
params.description: graphite TCP socket timeout (default=1)

params.name: token
params.description: The InfluxDB access token. Only necessary when using the http v2 api. If the v2 compatibility api is used, use 'user:password' instead.

params.name: verify-certificate
params.description: Set to 0 to disable certificate verification for https endpoints.
